leads.notes: Grade A (combined 80) — the only lead clearing 55 this run, and the strongest agency-overflow fit captured in several weeks. Everything Mark sells is in the brief: PR strategy, media relations, op-eds, thought leadership, journalist relationships, reporting that ties PR to business KPIs. Buyer type is the one Mark converts fastest — an agency that already has clients, budget and a delivery team, and needs a senior operator to own accounts. CAVEATS: (1) compensation is 'Negotiated' with no band, so rate discovery has to happen early or this burns time; (2) the posting carries no date and appears evergreen, which sometimes means bench-building rather than an active req — verify before investing pitch time; (3) 'potential to grow into a full-time role' signals they may ultimately want headcount, so Mark should frame the engagement as a retained partnership from the first conversation rather than letting it drift toward a trial-hire; (4) some responsibilities skew tactical (media list management, Reddit AMAs, Telegram/Discord community work) — scope those out or price them. ACTION: apply via the careers form AND email hello@castinfluence.com directly with 3 named B2B SaaS or fintech placements, a proposed monthly retainer covering 1-2 accounts, and an explicit statement that he works at the strategy and media-relations layer with their production team executing beneath him.
